title: AI and the End of Code

parts.visual:
A PM types into a terminal: 'Build me an app that connects to Spotify, creates a custom playlist based on my mood, and has a dark-mode interface.' Two minutes later, the AI writes 10,000 lines of perfect code, deploys the servers, and hands the PM a working link. The engineering team was not involved.

The AI Paradigm:
1. Code as a Commodity: For 40 years, the hardest part of building software was writing the syntax of code. Today, AI models can write perfect syntax. The bottleneck is no longer 'How do we build this?'. The bottleneck is 'What should we build?'.
2. The PM Renaissance: In a world where AI can build anything instantly, the value of pure engineering drops, and the value of extreme customer empathy, strategic vision, and complex problem-solving (the core skills of a PM) skyrockets.
parts.audio: When intelligence becomes free and code is generated instantly, the only humans who survive are the ones who know exactly what questions to ask the machine. The future of product management is prompting reality into existence.

questions.question: What is the new definition of an 'MVP' in the age of AI?
options: Speed to zero. A PM does not need a 4-week sprint to test an idea. They can use AI to instantly generate a working prototype in an afternoon, send it to a user, and validate the idea before dinner. The speed of iteration is approaching infinity.
An app that thinks for itself.
questions.correct_answer: Speed to zero. A PM does not need a 4-week sprint to test an idea. They can use AI to instantly generate a working prototype in an afternoon, send it to a user, and validate the idea before dinner. The speed of iteration is approaching infinity.
questions.explanation: If it takes longer than a day to test, you are moving too slow.

questions.question: Listen to the PM talking about their new 'Engineering' team. What is an 'Agentic Workflow'?
questions.tts_text: I don't have human developers anymore. I have three AI Agents. Agent A writes the code. Agent B reviews the code and looks for security flaws. Agent C tests the UI. My job as the PM is just to manage the conversation between the three AIs.
options: The orchestration of specialized AI models. Instead of humans doing the tasks, multiple AI 'Agents' are assigned specific roles (Coder, Reviewer, Tester) and they communicate with each other to complete complex projects autonomously.
A travel agency for tech workers.
questions.correct_answer: The orchestration of specialized AI models. Instead of humans doing the tasks, multiple AI 'Agents' are assigned specific roles (Coder, Reviewer, Tester) and they communicate with each other to complete complex projects autonomously.
questions.explanation: The PM is no longer managing humans; they are managing minds.

questions.question: Why does AI make 'Proprietary Data' the most important asset for a company?
options: If every company has access to the exact same super-intelligent AI (like GPT-5), the AI itself is not an advantage. The only advantage is feeding that AI with secret, highly valuable data that your competitors do not have. Data is the new Moat.

questions.explanation: Intelligence is free. Context is priceless.

questions.question: What is the 'Black Box Problem' that PMs must now manage?
options: Lack of explainability. If traditional code breaks, an engineer can read the code and find the exact bug. If an AI neural network gives a dangerous or racist answer to a user, it is a 'Black Box'. Nobody, not even the creators, knows exactly why it said it.

questions.explanation: Managing an intelligence you cannot fully comprehend.
